chat: Maria Lopez
Hi Isabella! You seem really busy today. Are you getting everything ready for the Valentine's Day gathering?
Isabella Rodriguez
I am! It's going to be such a lovely celebration for our customers. I'm putting the final touches on the decorations and menu. I'm so excited to have everyone here!
Maria Lopez
That sounds wonderful! I'm really looking forward to it. I heard you were putting together something special for February 14th.
Isabella Rodriguez
I truly hope you can make it! We're hoping to make it a warm and relaxed afternoon for everyone. Are you free on the 14th?
Maria Lopez
I think so! I'm really hoping to come. I'm looking forward to seeing what you come up with!
Isabella Rodriguez
It's scheduled from 5 pm to 7 pm. No pressure at all, but we would absolutely love to see you there! It's going to be a cozy evening.
Maria Lopez
That sounds perfect! 5 to 7 pm works great for me. I can't wait to check it out! Is there anything I can help with while you're getting everything ready?
Isabella Rodriguez

That is so kind of you, Maria! Honestly, you're already helping just by being enthusiastic! Right now, I'm just trying to manage the rush before the party. Maybe later this week, once things calm down a bit, we can chat about specific ways you might be able to lend a hand? For now, why don't you grab a coffee and just relax? It’s your day off!
Maria Lopez
Thanks, I will! It smells amazing in here anyway. I'll just take a minute to chill out, but maybe I'll stop by later this week when things are less crazy. 😊
